stories.headline: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs take ~$999M as BTC holds above $86K
stories.blurb: Monday’s haul was the strongest 2026 session; IBIT/ARKB/FBTC led, and Farside also shows +$364M on 22 Sep after the spike.

stories.headline: Short squeeze liquidates ~$650M as crypto open interest still rises
stories.blurb: CoinGlass-linked reports put ~$648M of shorts in a ~$747M liquidation burst while aggregate OI rose ~7.6%, leaving leverage rebuilt long.

stories.headline: BitMEX set to shut permanently on 23 Sep 2026
stories.blurb: Exchange winds down after 11 years and heavy U.S. penalties; remaining positions face force-close around the 04:00 UTC deadline.

stories.headline: Solana spot ETFs extend a 12-week inflow streak (~$1.4B cumulative)
stories.blurb: Week ending Sep 18 added ~$60.7M; SOL products kept drawing while BTC ETFs had just posted their quietest week earlier in September.

stories.headline: Ether and Solana ETFs also join the Monday flow surge
stories.blurb: Alongside BTC’s ~$999M, spot Ether ETFs added ~$270M and Solana products ~$26M on Sep 21 per flow trackers.
